scenario: [LFAC.2.5.1]: an object's member order carries no meaning. Two asserts of a `Json key` payload with the same members in the other order, nested one level down as well, are one identity, so one fact. A third payload differing in one leaf is a second fact. PATH PINNED: the identity-key comparison (libds `rete/wm_rete.c` `idkey_equal` and its hash, both through `json.c` `ds_json_deep_equal`; Mercury's `ds.json` term, whose members are stored sorted so `=` is the relation). The no-op test uses the same function in libds, so the two cannot drift apart.
